operations.label: Condition the arsenic precursor

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Prepare the amino-As/oleylamine solution in an N2 glovebox and heat until bubbling ceases. The source associates bubbling with transamination; no duration or isolated transaminated formula is assigned.

operations.label: Prepare the indium solution

environment.value: Glovebox; gas identity not separately specified in this sentence
environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Stir InCl3 with oleylamine and octadecene in a glovebox. The sentence does not state a distinct gas identity for this indium-conditioning step.

operations.label: Vacuum dry the reaction flask

environment.value: Vacuum at room temperature; pressure and numerical temperature unreported
environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Vacuum dry an empty 25 mL flask at room temperature on a standard Schlenk line. This step is parallel to precursor preparation; vacuum pressure is unknown.

operations.label: Charge under argon

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Switch the Schlenk line to Ar and inject the indium solution into the dried flask.

operations.label: Heat the indium solution

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Raise the solution to the source injection temperature. Ramp rate and dwell before injection are not given.

operations.label: Disperse the reducing agent
operations.description: Disperse 1 mmol sodium cyanoborohydride in 0.5 mL oleylamine; no temperature or conditioning time is stated.

operations.label: Co-inject arsenic precursor and reductant

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Inject the conditioned arsenic precursor together with the reducing-agent dispersion into the hot indium solution. No rate is supplied.

operations.label: React the mixture

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: React for 1 h following the 240 °C injection; the described reaction temperature is retained without inventing a separate temperature program.

operations.label: Cool and transfer
operations.description: Cool to room temperature and transfer into the glovebox. Numerical room temperature and cooling duration are absent.

operations.label: First mixed-solvent wash
operations.description: Wash with toluene, methanol and isopropanol; mixing proportions and volumes are absent.

operations.label: Separate first wash
operations.description: Centrifuge and discard the supernatant, retaining the precipitate.

operations.label: Two further washing cycles
operations.description: Perform two additional washes with toluene and ethanol. Each cycle is followed by 4500 rpm centrifugation for 10 min and supernatant disposal.

operations.label: Redisperse in toluene
operations.description: Disperse the final precipitate in toluene for characterization and electrochemical testing. Dispersion volume and concentration are unspecified.

quality.review_scope: Independent R3 scientific audit passed for complete six-page main and selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27 only. Remaining 42 SI pages remain unreviewed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete six-page main and explicitly selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27. Detailed electrochemical parameter tables and SI sections outside that page set remain unenriched; cited full sources unreviewed.

Pristine oleylamine-capped InAs, ligand-exchanged InAs, supported electrodes and post-electrolysis reconstruction are distinct specimen stages. The 2.2 nm TEM mean is assigned only to pristine QDs; no numeric size is remeasured after exchange.
The source gives flask volume, atmospheres and heating times but not vacuum pressure, injection rate, ramp, actual room temperature, cooling time or stirring rate.

Synthesis washing solvent volumes and mixing ratios, final dispersion volume and isolated yield are not given. Methanol purification comparison does not overwrite the explicitly reported first mixed-solvent wash and two later ethanol washes.
Reducing-agent and wash comparisons retain their stated variable; their complete specimen-specific schedule and quantitative phase fractions are unresolved.

Pristine and ligand-exchanged electrode recipes retain stated support dimensions and Nafion ratios. Drop-cast ink volumes and complete electrochemical tables are outside or unresolved within this declared extraction scope.
Reference ICSD structures and electrochemical active-phase interpretation are not measured particle atomic coordinates. No geometric molecular, surface or unit-cell model is asserted.
Independent source comparison passed within the declared main and selected-SI scope; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
